paragraphs: Bid Locker Inc. makes an online bid submission platform for government agencies. The company notes that many agencies post solicitations online but have no way to accept bids electronically. It describes the service as secure bid submission and e-procurement.

Vendors set up one profile and share it with every agency they would like to do business with. There is no cost to a vendor for using it. Setting up that profile takes about ten minutes. A vendor dashboard saves keyword searches and agency watchlists. Vendors can search open RFPs, ITBs and other contracting opportunities. Those searches can specify keyword tags and commodity codes. On the agency side, setting up a new solicitation for vendor bid submission takes moments. Submitted bids are then reviewed through a bid review dashboard.

Agencies from coast to coast use it to publish contracting opportunities. The agencies browsable by region include the Kentucky Community and Technical College System. Seattle Public Schools also appears on that list.
